question: Which of the following devices accepts the results produced by the computer in a machine-readable form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Printer.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Printer **accepts the results produced by the computer in a machine-readable form.
 
• A printer produces hard copies of the processed data. It enables the user, to print images, text, or any other information onto paper.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• There are 2__ types of printers that are there based on their printing techniques.
 
• A printer is an external output device.
 
• Two types of printers:
 
 
• Impact Printers
 
• Non-Impact Printers
 
 
 
• Impact Printers:
 
 
• An impact printer makes contact with the paper by pressing an inked ribbon against the paper using a hammer.
 
• Types of Impact Printers:
 
• Dot-Matrix Printers
 
• Daisy-Wheel Printers
 
• Line Printers
 
• Drum Printer
 
• Chain Printers
 
• Band Printers
 
 
 
• Non-Impact Printers:
 
 
• Non-impact printers do not use a striking device to produce characters.
 
• Types of Non-Impact Printers:
 
• Ink-Jet Printers
 
• Laser Printers
 
• Thermal Printer
